input.subject: Labster Automation: Failed to Send LabsterSubscription data to CSI Endpoint
input.body:
Hello Team,

#{_dp('{"pill_type":"job_context","path":["recipe_name"]}')} executed successfully but failed to call CSI endpoint to send LabsterSubscription data.

SF LabsterSubscriptionId: #{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_recipe_function","line":"2fa87a02","path":["parameters","LabsterSubscriptionId"]}')}

Recipe ID: #{_dp('{"pill_type":"job_context","path":["recipe_id"]}')}

Job ID: #{_dp('{"pill_type":"job_context","path":["job_id"]}')}

ErrorType: #{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"catch","line":"193f197d","path":["type"]}')}

ErrorMessage: #{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"workato_variable","line":"2d92a089","path":["EventMessage"]}')}



Please contact with System Administrator


Labster Automation Team

block.comment: If failed to call CSI endpoint then sand a mail to admin
